_doc: Pardon registry for scripts/lint_paid_llm_entity.py's per-route model judgment (catE step #40c). Four rules. (1) A pardon narrows ONLY the model's contribution to a verdict: violation = by_grep or bool(live), where live = fired - pardoned, and a grep hit is NEVER pardoned by any entry here. (2) A pardon is scoped to an exact (path, route) pair — no globs, no substring, no suffix — so it can never widen past the file and the route it names. (3) Growth needs its own PR: the lint compares this file's pardoned paths against the base ref before any model call, and a PR that adds a violation cannot pardon it away in the same diff — shrinking is always allowed, growing is not. (4) Delete the entry once the file is remediated or removed; a stale entry pointing at a path that no longer exists on disk fails the shipped-list validator. Entry shape (ALL required): {path: repo-relative posix path exact, routes: [key of ROUTE_QUESTIONS, ...], reason: why the model misread the file, pr: int, date: YYYY-MM-DD}. Optional `observed` (route→probability) is not read by code — it is a note for the next human, not a threshold.
